generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies carrying TIV or sums insured across every line, peril, and CRESTA zone.
generic.In-scope period: In-force position as at the agreed exposure cut-off date for the current treaty year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each policy row carries line of business, peril code, location or CRESTA zone, TIV, and currency.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregated gross TIV and policy count tie to the policy admin in-force premium register within tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aggregation workbook stored with the extract timestamp and the policy admin extract version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with missing peril code or blank location listed with a fix, exclude, or accept disposition.
generic.Test population: The full aggregated in-force exposure set by line, peril, and geography at the cut-off date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Gross TIV reconciles to the in-force register within tolerance and no null peril codes remain in scope.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved missing peril or location records are referred to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when totals reconcile, the as-at date is recorded, and every exception carries a disposition.
generic.Evidence location: Exposure aggregation folder in the lakehouse with the Excel summary and reconciliation attached.

steps.title: Extract in-force TIV and sums insured from the policy administration system
sop: Run the in-force extract in the policy administration system at the agreed cut-off date.
Include policy number, line, peril code, location, CRESTA zone, TIV, and currency.
Done when the in-force extract file is produced with its as-at date stamped.
verify: Check the extract as-at date matches the agreed cut-off date.
Pass when the extract exists with the correct as-at date and all required columns.

steps.title: Load the extract into the enterprise data warehouse staging area
sop: Load the extract into the lakehouse exposure staging table for the treaty year.
Confirm the loaded row count equals the extract row count.
Done when the staged exposure table is populated and row counts match.
verify: Compare staged row count to the source extract row count.
Pass when staged and source row counts are identical.

steps.title: Aggregate exposure by line, peril, and CRESTA zone in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pivot the staged exposure by line of business, peril, and CRESTA or postcode zone.
Sum TIV and policy count for each combination and hold currency separately.
Done when the aggregated exposure summary is built across all three dimensions.
verify: Check every line, peril, and zone combination present in staging appears in the summary.
Pass when no populated combination is missing from the aggregation.

steps.title: Reconcile aggregated gross TIV to the in-force premium register
sop: Compare aggregated gross TIV and policy count to the policy admin in-force premium register.
Investigate any difference above the agreed tolerance and record the cause.
Done when the reconciliation is completed and differences are explained.
verify: Check the reconciling difference against the agreed tolerance.
Pass when the difference is within tolerance or fully explained in writing.

steps.title: Flag policies with missing peril codes or blank location fields
sop: Filter the staged exposure for null peril code or blank location or zone.
List each affected policy with its TIV and assign a disposition.
Done when the exception list is complete with a disposition on every row.
verify: Check no exception row is left without a disposition.
Pass when every flagged policy carries a fix, exclude, or accept decision.

steps.title: Confirm facultative assumed treatment and release the aggregation
sop: Confirm whether inward facultative assumed business is included or excluded and state it on the summary.
Review the reconciliation and exception list before release.
Done when the aggregation is released for downstream modelling and structuring.
verify: Check the released summary states the facultative assumed treatment explicitly.
Pass when the release is recorded with the facultative treatment stated and exceptions dispositioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final net-retention strategy covering per-risk and per-event retentions for every line of business.
generic.In-scope period: Retentions applying from the stated effective date through the current treaty year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval record carries pack version, per-risk and per-event values, approver name, and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every approved retention value matches the presented pack or a minuted in-session amendment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval filed in the model governance repository with the approved pack version and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-session amendments to retention values logged with the reason and the amended figure.
generic.Test population: All per-risk and per-event retention values in the approved net-retention strategy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approval is valid only with a named approver, date, pack version, and stated effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Values differing from the pack without a minuted amendment are returned to the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when signed approval, actuarial opinion, and effective date are all recorded together.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository approval folder with the SharePoint retention pack version linked.

steps.title: Confirm the retention pack version in SharePoint matches the version tabled
sop: Open the retention recommendation pack in SharePoint and note its version reference.
Confirm the tabled pack is the same version with no later draft outstanding.
Done when the pack version to be approved is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check the recorded version reference against the SharePoint file version history.
Pass when the approved version reference matches the tabled pack exactly.

steps.title: Capture the actuarial function opinion on reinsurance adequacy
sop: State the actuarial opinion on the adequacy of the proposed reinsurance arrangement.
Record any reservation or condition attached to that opinion.
Done when the actuarial opinion is recorded against the pack version.
verify: Check the opinion is written, attributed, and dated.
Pass when a dated actuarial opinion covering adequacy is on file.

steps.title: Record per-risk and per-event retention values as approved
sop: Record the approved per-risk retention by line and the per-event catastrophe retention.
Record any amendment made in session with the original and amended value.
Done when every approved retention value is written into the approval record.
verify: Compare each recorded value to the pack and to the minuted amendments.
Pass when no recorded value differs from the pack without a minuted amendment.

steps.title: Obtain signed approval from the Head of Reinsurance
sop: Sign the approval page confirming the retention values and pack version.
Note CFO and CUO concurrence and any condition attached.
Done when the signed approval carries approver name and date.
verify: Check the signature block for name, role, and date.
Pass when the approval is signed and dated by the Head of Reinsurance.

steps.title: Set the effective date from which the approved retentions apply
sop: State the date from which the approved retentions take effect.
Confirm the date aligns with the treaty year and planned placement dates.
Done when the effective date is stated on the approval record.
verify: Check the effective date is not earlier than the approval date without a stated reason.
Pass when a coherent effective date is recorded on the approval.

steps.title: File the signed approval in the model governance repository
sop: Upload the signed approval and the approved pack version to the governance repository.
Link the approval reference to the retention rationale document.
Done when the approval is filed and retrievable by its reference.
verify: Retrieve the filed approval by its reference and check the pack version attached.
Pass when the signed approval and matching pack version are both retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The selected peer set of reinsurers matched on line mix, premium size, and territory.
generic.In-scope period: Most recent published peer financials and current rating-agency capital adequacy commentary.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each peer row carries retention, surplus, gross written premium, and the source of the figures.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Peer retention ratios recompute from the stated surplus and premium figures without difference.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmarking workbook retained with the peer data extraction date and source document versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Peers excluded from the set logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All peers in the selected set plus the company's own retention ratios.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Own retention must be positioned against the peer quartile range and the agency guidance threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Outlier positions versus the peer range are explained in writing or escalated to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when peer basis, own ratios, agency guidance, and the implication for retention are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmarking workbook in the lakehouse analysis folder with the Excel exhibit for the retention pack.

steps.title: Select the peer set and record the selection basis in Microsoft Excel
sop: Select peers matched on line mix, premium size, and territory.
Record the matching criteria and list any peer excluded with the reason.
Done when the peer set and its selection basis are documented.
verify: Check each peer against the stated matching criteria.
Pass when every peer in the set meets the recorded selection basis.

steps.title: Pull peer retention, surplus, and premium data into the warehouse workbook
sop: Extract published retention, surplus, and gross written premium for each peer.
Record the source document and its date for every figure.
Done when the peer data table is populated with sources cited.
verify: Check each peer figure traces to a cited source document.
Pass when no peer figure lacks a dated source reference.

steps.title: Express own retention as a percentage of surplus and of gross written premium
sop: Calculate own per-risk and per-event retention as a percentage of surplus.
Calculate the same retentions as a percentage of gross written premium.
Done when both own comparability ratios are calculated.
verify: Recompute the ratios from the underlying surplus and premium figures.
Pass when recomputed ratios match the stated ratios.

steps.title: Compare against rating-agency retention guidance thresholds
sop: Retrieve the current rating-agency capital adequacy commentary on retention guidance.
Compare own ratios against the stated guidance thresholds.
Done when the position versus agency guidance is recorded.
verify: Check the agency commentary cited is the current published version.
Pass when the comparison cites a current, dated agency source.

steps.title: Position own retention against the peer quartile range
sop: Calculate the peer quartile range for each retention ratio.
Mark where own retention sits and explain any outlier position.
Done when own position versus the quartile range is documented with explanation.
verify: Check every outlier position carries a written explanation.
Pass when no outlier is left unexplained.

steps.title: State the benchmarking implication for the recommended retention range
sop: Draw the conclusion on whether own retention is high, low, or in line with peers.
State the implied retention range for the recommendation.
Done when the benchmarking conclusion and implied range are documented.
verify: Check the conclusion follows from the peer and agency comparisons shown.
Pass when the implied range is supported by the exhibits in the workbook.

generic.Defined scope/population: Underwriting, ceded operations, and pricing teams plus all systems holding retention parameters.
generic.In-scope period: From the approved retention effective date through the treaty year the limits apply to.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Communication states per-risk and per-event values, effective date, and treaty year for each line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retention values in the policy admin and reinsurance admin systems match the approved retention table.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued retention notice retained with send date, recipient list, and approved pack version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Teams or systems not updated by the effective date logged with owner and remediation date.
generic.Test population: All active treaty records and underwriting referral thresholds affected by the new retentions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No active treaty or referral threshold may still carry the superseded prior-year retention value.
generic.Exception handling path: Systems still holding superseded values are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager for immediate correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when all recipients acknowledge and both systems reflect the approved values and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Distribution log in the email and Teams record with system update evidence from the reinsurance admin system.

steps.title: Issue the approved retention table to underwriting, ceded ops, and pricing
sop: Send the approved per-risk and per-event retention table by email and Teams.
Name the approved pack version and the approval reference in the message.
Done when the retention table has been issued to all three teams.
verify: Check the sent message against the intended recipient list.
Pass when every named team received the retention table.

steps.title: State the effective date and treaty year in the communication
sop: State the date from which the retentions apply and the treaty year covered.
State that prior-year values are superseded from that date.
Done when the effective date and treaty year are stated in the issued notice.
verify: Check the notice text carries both the effective date and treaty year.
Pass when both are present and consistent with the approval record.

steps.title: Update underwriting referral and authority limits in the policy admin system
sop: Update referral thresholds and authority limits to the new retention values.
Set the change to take effect on the stated effective date.
Done when referral and authority limits reflect the approved retentions.
verify: Query referral thresholds in the policy admin system for the affected lines.
Pass when every threshold equals the approved retention with the correct effective date.

steps.title: Update retention parameters on treaty records in the reinsurance admin system
sop: Update the retention parameter on each active treaty record.
Confirm no active treaty still carries the prior-year retention.
Done when all active treaty records hold the approved retention values.
verify: List active treaties and compare their retention parameter to the approved table.
Pass when no active treaty carries a superseded retention value.

steps.title: Collect acknowledgements from each recipient team lead
sop: Request written acknowledgement from underwriting, ceded operations, and pricing leads.
Chase any lead who has not responded before the effective date.
Done when an acknowledgement is held from every recipient team lead.
verify: Check the acknowledgement log against the recipient list.
Pass when every recipient team lead has acknowledged.

steps.title: Log outstanding system or team gaps with owners and remediation dates
sop: List any system or team not aligned to the new retentions by the effective date.
Assign an owner and remediation date to each gap.
Done when every gap carries an owner and a remediation date.
verify: Check each logged gap has an owner and a date.
Pass when no gap is recorded without owner and remediation date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All retention options analysed for the cycle plus the recommended retention by line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The retention setting cycle preceding the treaty year the recommendation applies to.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack contains recommendation, options exhibit, capital and cost exhibit, stress results, and sign-off page.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures in the pack agree to the source scenario and stress workbooks with no restated numbers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack saved in SharePoint with a version number and the date it was assembled.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any exhibit missing at assembly logged with owner and the date it will be added.
generic.Test population: Every section of the assembled retention recommendation pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pack is complete only with recommendation, options, stress, benchmarking, and an unsigned sign-off page.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or inconsistent exhibits are returned to the Reinsurance Actuary before the pack is circulated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when all five required sections are present and figures tie to their source workbooks.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint retention pack library with the supporting Excel exhibits linked to the pack version.

steps.title: Draft the recommendation section with alternatives considered and rejected
sop: State the recommended retention by line of business.
List each alternative considered and the reason it was rejected.
Done when the recommendation section names the recommendation and rejected alternatives.
verify: Check every alternative modelled appears with a rejection reason.
Pass when no modelled alternative is omitted from the section.

steps.title: Attach the capital relief and cost-of-cover exhibit for each option
sop: Insert the capital relief and net cost of cover figures for every retention option.
Confirm the figures agree to the scenario workbook.
Done when the exhibit is attached for all options.
verify: Trace a sample of exhibit figures back to the scenario workbook.
Pass when sampled figures match the scenario workbook exactly.

steps.title: Insert the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 stress results at the recommended retention
sop: Insert net loss at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods for the recommended retention.
State the tolerance threshold alongside each result.
Done when both stress results and their tolerances are shown.
verify: Compare the inserted results to the stress-testing output.
Pass when both return-period figures match the stress workbook.

steps.title: Insert the peer benchmarking exhibit and agency commentary
sop: Insert the peer benchmarking exhibit with own position versus the quartile range.
Include the rating-agency guidance commentary reference.
Done when benchmarking and agency commentary are in the pack.
verify: Check the benchmarking exhibit version matches the completed benchmarking analysis.
Pass when the exhibit matches the source benchmarking workbook.

steps.title: Add the sign-off page for Head of Reinsurance, CUO, and CFO
sop: Add a sign-off page listing Head of Reinsurance, CUO, and CFO with date fields.
Leave the page unsigned pending the approval session.
Done when the unsigned sign-off page is present in the pack.
verify: Check all three named signatories and date fields appear on the page.
Pass when the sign-off page is present, complete, and unsigned.

steps.title: Version and publish the assembled pack to SharePoint
sop: Review the assembled pack for completeness across all five sections.
Publish it to the SharePoint retention pack library with a version number.
Done when the versioned pack is published and circulated for the approval session.
verify: Open the published pack and confirm all five sections are present.
Pass when the published version contains every required section.

generic.Defined scope/population: Per-risk retention for every line of business plus the per-event catastrophe retention.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year for which retentions are being set, using the current in-force exposure basis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each selected retention carries the modelled net loss, earnings-at-risk, and capital impact beside it.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled net losses at each retention agree to the actuarial platform scenario outputs.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retention selection workbook retained with the model version and run date used to support it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any retention breaching a board quantitative limit logged with the escalation and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All candidate per-risk and per-event retention values tested in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No selected retention may project a solvency ratio below the internal capital target.
generic.Exception handling path: Retentions failing the solvency floor are rejected and re-set by the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every value is recorded with net loss, capital impact, and a passed appetite test.
generic.Evidence location: Retention selection workbook in the lakehouse with the actuarial platform run reference recorded.

steps.title: Set per-risk retention by line against the earnings-at-risk tolerance
sop: Set a candidate per-risk retention for each line of business.
Compare the resulting earnings at risk to the approved tolerance.
Done when a candidate per-risk retention is set for every line.
verify: Check each line has a candidate value with its earnings-at-risk figure.
Pass when no line is left without a candidate retention and tolerance test.

steps.title: Set the per-event catastrophe retention against the 1-in-N net loss tolerance
sop: Set the per-event retention using the modelled OEP curve.
Compare net loss at the approved return period to the tolerance.
Done when the per-event retention candidate is set and tested.
verify: Check the net loss figure ties to the cat model output.
Pass when the per-event candidate is supported by a modelled net loss.

steps.title: Test each proposed retention in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Run each candidate retention through the capital model.
Record the projected solvency ratio and required capital for each.
Done when every candidate has a modelled solvency and capital result.
verify: Check each candidate has a recorded solvency ratio.
Pass when no candidate lacks a modelled solvency result.

steps.title: Compare results to the solvency floor and internal capital target
sop: Compare each candidate's projected solvency ratio to the internal capital target.
Reject any candidate falling below the target and record the rejection.
Done when every candidate is marked pass or fail against the capital target.
verify: Check no retained candidate falls below the internal capital target.
Pass when all surviving candidates meet or exceed the capital target.

steps.title: Confirm the selection against board-approved quantitative risk limits
sop: Check the selected retentions against the board-approved quantitative risk limits.
Log and escalate any breach with the proposed treatment.
Done when the selection is confirmed against every applicable board limit.
verify: Check each applicable board limit has been tested against the selection.
Pass when no untested board limit remains and any breach is logged.

steps.title: Record selected values with net loss and capital impact in Microsoft Excel
sop: Record the final per-risk and per-event values in the selection workbook.
Record the modelled net loss and capital impact alongside each value.
Done when every selected value is recorded with its supporting metrics.
verify: Check each recorded value carries net loss and capital impact figures.
Pass when no selected value is recorded without supporting metrics.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved net-retention strategy, the rejected alternatives, and the appetite metrics tested.
generic.In-scope period: The retention setting cycle covered by the signed approval record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rationale names selected value, rejected alternatives, appetite metrics, model version, and limitations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every retention value cited in the rationale matches the signed approval record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale filed in the model governance repository with a version and cross-reference to the approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations recorded with their effect on the conclusion and any mitigating action.
generic.Test population: All retention decisions documented in the rationale for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rationale is complete only if rejected alternatives, appetite metrics, and model version are all named.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps found at review are returned to the Reinsurance Analyst before the rationale is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the rationale is cross-referenced to the signed approval and reviewed by the Manager.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository rationale folder with the SharePoint working papers linked.

steps.title: Record why the selected retention was chosen over each rejected alternative
sop: List each alternative retention considered in the cycle.
State the specific reason the selected value was preferred to each.
Done when every rejected alternative carries a written reason.
verify: Check the alternatives listed match those in the recommendation pack.
Pass when no alternative from the pack is missing a rejection reason.

steps.title: Document the appetite metric and threshold each retention was tested against
sop: Name the appetite metric applied to each per-risk and per-event retention.
State the threshold value and the tested result.
Done when every retention has a named metric, threshold, and result.
verify: Check each retention in the approval has a matching appetite test.
Pass when no approved retention lacks a documented appetite test.

steps.title: List the model, version, and parameter set used to support the decision
sop: Record the actuarial and cat model names and versions used.
Record the parameter set and run reference for each supporting result.
Done when model versions and run references are documented.
verify: Check the recorded run references resolve in the governance repository.
Pass when every cited run reference is retrievable.

steps.title: State known data limitations affecting the retention analysis
sop: List the data quality or coverage limitations affecting the analysis.
State the likely direction and size of their effect on the conclusion.
Done when each limitation is recorded with its assessed effect.
verify: Check limitations raised in the exposure validation appear in the list.
Pass when no known validation limitation is omitted.

steps.title: Cross-reference the rationale to the signed approval record
sop: Insert the approval reference and pack version into the rationale document.
Confirm the retention values cited match the signed approval.
Done when the cross-reference is in place and values agree.
verify: Compare cited retention values to the signed approval record.
Pass when every cited value matches the approval.

steps.title: Review and file the rationale in the model governance repository
sop: Review the rationale for completeness against the five required elements.
File the reviewed version in the governance repository with a version number.
Done when the reviewed rationale is filed and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the filed rationale and check all five elements are present.
Pass when the filed version contains all five required elements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every per-risk and per-event retention limit set for the cycle across all lines of business.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year covered by the current board-approved risk appetite statement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each mapping row carries the retention, the named appetite limit, escalation trigger, and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The count of mapped retentions equals the count of retentions in the approved retention table.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping table saved in SharePoint citing the board-approved appetite statement version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retentions sitting outside the stated tolerance logged as exceptions with the agreed treatment.
generic.Test population: All per-risk and per-event retention limits in the approved retention table.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No retention limit may be left unmapped to a named risk appetite metric.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-tolerance retentions are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager and recorded as appetite exceptions.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every retention maps to a named limit and the appetite version cited is current.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint appetite mapping library with the Excel mapping table attached to the retention pack.

steps.title: Retrieve the current board-approved appetite statement from SharePoint
sop: Open the risk appetite statement library and select the current approved version.
Record the version reference and board approval date.
Done when the current appetite version is identified and recorded.
verify: Check no later approved version exists in the library.
Pass when the cited version is the latest board-approved one.

steps.title: Map each per-risk retention to its underwriting appetite limit
sop: List each per-risk retention by line of business.
Name the underwriting risk appetite limit it is constrained by.
Done when every per-risk retention has a named appetite limit.
verify: Count mapped per-risk retentions against the approved retention table.
Pass when the counts match with no unmapped per-risk retention.

steps.title: Map each per-event retention to catastrophe and earnings volatility tolerances
sop: Name the catastrophe tolerance and earnings volatility tolerance for each per-event retention.
Record the threshold value from the appetite statement.
Done when each per-event retention carries both tolerance references.
verify: Check each per-event mapping cites a threshold from the appetite statement.
Pass when every per-event retention has a cited threshold.

steps.title: Identify retentions sitting outside the stated tolerance
sop: Compare each retention's tested result to its mapped tolerance.
Mark any line breaching tolerance as an appetite exception.
Done when every retention is marked in or out of tolerance.
verify: Check each out-of-tolerance line is recorded as an exception.
Pass when no breach is left unmarked.

steps.title: Record the escalation trigger and owner for each mapped limit
sop: State the trigger level at which each mapped limit escalates.
Name the owner accountable for monitoring that limit.
Done when every mapping row carries a trigger and an owner.
verify: Check no mapping row is missing a trigger or an owner.
Pass when trigger and owner are populated on every row.

steps.title: Review the completed mapping table with the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Review the mapping for completeness and correct appetite references.
Approve the exception treatments proposed for out-of-tolerance lines.
Done when the mapping table is reviewed and the exceptions are accepted.
verify: Check the review is recorded against the mapping version.
Pass when a dated review is recorded and all exceptions carry a treatment.
